fda510k.q: Did they give you an FDA 510(k) number? It starts with K, like K231685.
fda510k.zh: 请提供这台设备的美国FDA 510(k)编号。
fda510k.en: Please give me this machine's US FDA 510(k) number.
fda510k.verify: Look it up: search “FDA 510k database” and type the K-number. The company and model must match.

fdalist.q: Is this exact model in the US FDA device list? Ask for the listing or registration number.
fdalist.zh: 这个型号在美国FDA有注册或列名吗？请提供编号。
fdalist.en: Is this model registered or listed with the US FDA? Please give the number.
fdalist.verify: Harris can check it on the FDA registration and listing database.

fdareg.q: Is the factory registered with the US FDA? Ask for the registration number.
fdareg.zh: 贵公司在美国FDA有工厂注册吗？请提供注册号。
fdareg.en: Is your factory registered with the US FDA? Please give the registration number.
fdareg.verify: Harris checks it on the FDA establishment registration database.

ul.q: Does it have a UL, ETL or CSA mark? Ask for the certificate or file number. CE doesn't count.
ul.zh: 有UL或ETL认证吗？请提供证书编号。
ul.en: Does it have UL or ETL certification? Please give the certificate number.
ul.verify: Look it up in UL Product iQ or the Intertek (ETL) directory.

power.q: Can they make it for US power, 110–120V and 60Hz, with a US plug?
power.zh: 可以做美国电压110伏、60赫兹，配美标插头吗？
power.en: Can it be made for US power, 110V 60Hz, with a US plug?
power.verify: The voltage must be written on the quote and on the label.

lic.q: Did they give you the business license and credit code? It should say 在营 (“active”).
lic.zh: 请提供营业执照和统一社会信用代码。
lic.en: Please send your business license and credit code.
lic.verify: Search the name on gsxt.gov.cn. It must say 在营 (“active”).

inspect.q: Will they accept an inspection by SGS or QIMA before shipping?
inspect.zh: 可以接受第三方验货（SGS或QIMA）吗？
inspect.en: Do you accept third-party inspection (SGS or QIMA)?
inspect.verify: A “no” here is a red flag.

fob.q: Did you get a price FOB Dalian, with delivery time, in writing?
fob.zh: 大连港离岸价（FOB）是多少？交货期多久？
fob.en: What is the FOB price at Dalian port, and how long is delivery?
fob.verify: Take a photo of the written quote.

usdealer.q: Is there a US dealer or US office that sells and services it?
usdealer.zh: 在美国有经销商或售后服务吗？
usdealer.en: Is there a US dealer or US service for this?
usdealer.verify: Buy through the US dealer so service and warranty work in New Jersey.

english.q: Is the software and report in English?
english.zh: 软件和报告有英文版吗？
english.en: Is the software and the report available in English?
english.verify: Ask them to switch the demo to English and take a photo.

data.q: Is member data stored outside China, or can it stay on our own computer?
data.zh: 用户数据存在哪里？可以存在美国或本地吗？
data.en: Where is user data stored? Can it stay in the US or on our own computer?
data.verify: Health data on a Chinese server is a problem for a US clinic.

fire.q: Does the fabric have a fire-safety certificate (like CAL 117)?
fire.zh: 面料有防火认证吗？比如美国CAL 117。
fire.en: Does the fabric have a fire-safety certificate, like US CAL 117?
